claim: The exact microscopic action remains Z6 symmetric during selector evolution
basis: Every selector, reheaton, threshold, gauge and matter coupling appears in a complete cyclic orbit
limitation_or_next_test: Requires an anomaly-free regulator and ultimately a discrete-gauge UV completion

claim: A fixed asymmetric state can generate p=1,...,5 harmonics without generating a hard vacuum spurion
basis: Closed-time-path covariance moves the Z6 transformation between background fields and the density matrix
limitation_or_next_test: State harmonics are physical only while the corresponding occupations or condensates persist

claim: No connected two-loop 1PI graph contains both Q0 and a in the displayed v0.9 interaction graph
basis: Two-loop topology audit: Q-R and R-H skeletons are a-independent; the a-dependent skeleton is Psi-gluon exchange
limitation_or_next_test: The first mixed order is portal-content dependent and must be audited at three loops and beyond

claim: Vacuum p=1,...,5 harmonics cancel through two loops
basis: Identical sector vacuum functionals obey the root-of-unity projector; symbolic and numerical Fourier checks pass
limitation_or_next_test: Fails if sector renormalization environments differ or a hard asymmetric coupling is introduced

claim: The first vacuum harmonic remains p=6 and begins at O(epsilon^6)
basis: Exact Z6 plus analyticity and epsilon as the only shift-breaking spurion
limitation_or_next_test: Requires phase sequestering; exact Z6 alone permits Q-charged transient operators

claim: Every two-loop lower harmonic contains a selector/background spurion or a statistical-state insertion
basis: Vacuum/state decomposition of the CTP propagators and the topology audit
limitation_or_next_test: Assumes no stable sector-charged vacuum condensate

claim: Bulk UV counterterms are the same Z6-symmetric counterterms as in vacuum
basis: UV-soft/Hadamard state insertions fall at high momentum; initial-state divergences are boundary localized
limitation_or_next_test: A non-Hadamard state requires explicit initial-surface counterterms

claim: The asymmetric thermal harmonic decays rather than becoming a late Wilson coefficient
basis: Exact Fermi-Dirac scalar-density integral redshifts and Boltzmann suppresses the state term by >10^138 in the benchmark scan
limitation_or_next_test: A stable relic population would leave a finite-density term, still not a vacuum term

claim: Two-loop QCD corrections preserve the reheating-selected phase
basis: NLO massive-quark pressure changes the phasor amplitude by 6.19% and the phase by only -0.00984 degrees at mu=2piT
limitation_or_next_test: High-temperature expansion and one-loop alpha_s running; full real-time resummation remains

claim: A gapped retarded kernel loses memory of the transient selector
basis: Spectral representation and numerical dephasing test give late/early RMS 1.76e-6
limitation_or_next_test: A zero-frequency pole, conserved charge or stable condensate can preserve memory

claim: Asymmetry in the state, symmetry in the action is a genuine two-loop radiative escape hatch
basis: C1-C10 together exclude a permanent lower-harmonic bulk coefficient through two loops
limitation_or_next_test: Not yet an all-orders theorem and not yet a nonperturbative preheating calculation

claim: The existing 2/27 visible-QCD transmission coefficient is unaffected by this audit
basis: The state-selected reheating sector does not alter the visible heavy-threshold decoupling chain
limitation_or_next_test: Higher-order ordinary QCD threshold corrections remain calculable

claim: The selector/reheaton chronology is parametrically separated
basis: Only 1.40% of R0 decays within one selector lifetime; 0.141% if Gamma_Q=10 GeV
limitation_or_next_test: Needs a non-equilibrium simulation of the actual rolling selector rather than exponential ansatz

claim: Exact Z6 by itself is sufficient to protect against every selector-induced low harmonic
basis: Z6 permits operators e^{ipx} Q_{-p}; they are transient but allowed
limitation_or_next_test: Add continuous shift-spurion sequestering or a Wilson-line/collective-pNGB completion

claim: The complete UV theory has been proven radiatively safe to all orders
limitation_or_next_test: Prove an all-orders sequestering theorem and calculate the first nonzero mixed selector-threshold matching order
Requires lattice preheating or Kadanoff-Baym evolution with the full selector/reheaton system
